scope: Additive Dragon Duke Rocket Backpack L1-27 dash, penetration, Flame Blower and Phoenix interaction audit.
game_version: Official May-August 2026 balance and dash fixes; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: State of Gameplay - Part 2
facts: Official table lowers L21 penetrating damage from 1925 to 1875 and L27 from 2200 to 2150.
sources.limitations: The table does not specify L22-26 replacement values or projectile, dash and penetration timing.

sources.title: THE ANIME FURY UPDATE IS HERE
facts: Equipment activation order is fixed by identity, not slot: Flame Blower activates before Rocket Backpack.
sources.limitations: No intra-tick subphase or facing sample is specified.

sources.title: July Balance Update
facts: The Flame Blower direction change sometimes prevented Rocket Backpack activation, so the older Backpack direction was temporarily restored.
sources.limitations: This is superseded by the August fix and is not a current combat rule.

sources.title: August Update
facts: Dash sometimes lacked its flame or stopped early; both were fixed.
Dragon Duke finishes a Rocket Backpack dash before defeat even when Phoenix temporary revival ends mid-dash.
Flame Blower fires in Duke's facing direction after the fix.
sources.limitations: Dash path, speed, flame hit timing, invulnerability, collision, death delay and facing sample are not defined.

sources.title: Rocket Backpack — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table matches pinned L1-27 HP bonus 900-3200, DPS bonus 20-86 and ore costs.
sources.limitations: No current penetrating damage, recovery, dash geometry or tick schedule is published.

sources.title: Pinned Rocket Backpack Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned damageArea label is 4 tiles, ability damage is 575-2200, HP recovery increase 300-2000, HP bonus 900-3200 and DPS bonus 20-86.
sources.limitations: Pinned L21/L27 damage predates official May reductions; the raw record does not define dash trajectory, duration, collision, target classes or damage timing.

derivations.result: Official L21/L27 penetrating damage supersedes pinned values at those levels; current dash completes before defeat and precedes death after Phoenix revival expiry
derivations.method: Order May, June, July and August primary notices chronologically, preserve frozen raw damage for provenance and retain only explicitly replaced levels.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply 1875 damage to L22-23 and 2150 to L24-26
rejected_inferences.reason: The official table names only L21 and L27; intermediate replacement values are not provided.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use pinned 1925 at L21 or 2200 at L27 in combat
rejected_inferences.reason: The official May 2026 table explicitly supersedes both.

rejected_inferences.rule: Teleport Duke to village center or make him immune to all attacks while dashing
rejected_inferences.reason: The ability description lacks exact path, travel speed, damage avoidance classes, collision and target behavior.

rejected_inferences.rule: End the dash when Phoenix revival expires
rejected_inferences.reason: The August 2026 fix explicitly makes the Duke finish the dash before defeat.

rejected_inferences.rule: Let UI slot order put Backpack before Flame Blower
rejected_inferences.reason: The June update fixes activation order by Equipment identity.

items: current penetrating damage L22-26 and other active value continuity
dash start, path, speed, center definition, collision and termination tick
damage area shape, target classes, hit phase, recovery and damage avoidance
Flame Blower facing sample and same-tick Equipment order
Phoenix revival expiry, death, Pet and trap interaction details
Viewer dash/flame rendering, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Rocket Backpack L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official May 2026 damage reductions at L21/L27 and August dash, flame and Phoenix-death fixes are recorded separately from the frozen raw series. Current intermediate damage, dash path, collision, damage and fixed-tick lifecycle are unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
